steps.name: 装 Blender 5.2.2 + 3D Print Toolbox（Windows 另放 Mesa 软件 OpenGL）
OpenGL 诊断（只打印，不判）
cmd: import subprocess,sys,pathlib;o=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);r=subprocess.run([sys.argv[1],'-c',sys.argv[3],str(o)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=240);print('rc',r.returncode);print(o.read_text(encoding='utf-8') if o.is_file() else '没有诊断输出：'+(r.stdout+r.stderr)[-800:])

import ctypes,sys,traceback
f=open(sys.argv[1],'w',encoding='utf-8')
try:
 h=ctypes.WinDLL('opengl32');b=ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(1024)
 ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetModuleFileNameW(ctypes.c_void_p(h._handle),b,1024);f.write('opengl32 = %s\n'%b.value)
 import pyrender;r=pyrender.OffscreenRenderer(64,64);from OpenGL import GL
 f.write('GL_VERSION = %r RENDERER = %r\n'%(GL.glGetString(GL.GL_VERSION),GL.glGetString(GL.GL_RENDERER)));r.delete()
except Exception:
 f.write(traceback.format_exc())
f.close()

steps.name: 自检报告摘要（只打印，不判）
cmd: import json,sys,pathlib;p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if p.is_file() else None;print('自检报告不存在' if d is None else '自检：%d 项必需失败 / 共 %d 项' % (d['n_fail_int'], d['n_check_int']));[print('  ✗', r.get('name_str'), (r.get('error_str') or '')[:300], '\n', (r.get('traceback_str') or '')[-1500:]) for r in (d or {}).get('result_list', []) if not r.get('ok_bool')];logs=sorted(p.parent.glob('gui_logs/**/*.log'));[print('== gui 日志', f.name, '\n', ''.join(l for l in f.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines(True) if any(k in l for k in ('viewer','3D','Error','error','VTK','vtk','OpenGL','Traceback','Exception')))[-3000:]) for f in logs[-3:]]

steps.name: apt 装 Qt / EGL / GLU / Mesa / Blender 需要的系统库
cmd: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq libegl1 libgl1 libopengl0 libglu1-mesa libgl1-mesa-dri libegl-mesa0 libosmesa6 libxkbcommon0 libxkbcommon-x11-0 libfontconfig1 libdbus-1-3 libxcb-cursor0 libxi6 libxxf86vm1 libxfixes3 libxrender1 libsm6 libice6 libx11-6 >/dev/null && echo apt-ok
